name: David Furr
bio: David Furr is an actor and director.

credits.title: A Long Winter
credits.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

credits.title: Driven
credits.overview: Teddy Fischer is an Uber driver and failed novelist who is living in her brother’s laundry room. While contemplating suicide, Teddy gets a ride request from Yari Alvarez, an overly confident, deaf yodeler, who insists that Teddy drive her to her parents’ McMansion to defend her as a fellow artist.

credits.title: Stevenson - Lost and Found
credits.overview: Writer and artist, James Stevenson was one of The New Yorker Magazine’s most prolific cartoonists. Revered for its weighty commentary on world affairs, The New Yorker found its sweet side in the wit, whimsy and sheer joie de vivre of Jim’s illustrations and articles. credits.title: The Highwaymen
credits.overview: In 1934, Frank Hamer and Manny Gault, two former Texas Rangers, are commissioned to put an end to the wave of vicious crimes perpetrated by Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow, a notorious duo of infamous robbers and cold-blooded killers who nevertheless are worshiped by the public.

credits.title: The Sounding
credits.overview: On a remote island off the coast of Maine, Liv, after years of silence, begins to weave a language out of Shakespeare's words. credits.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi
credits.overview: An American Ambassador is killed during an attack at a U.S. compound in Libya as a security team struggles to make sense out of the chaos.

credits.title: Anche se è amore non si vede
credits.overview: Salvo and Valentino are two Sicilian friends who have moved to Turin, and now run a small business together. They drive foreign tourists around in a double-decker bus, and Salvo always tries to approach the pretty girls.

credits.title: The Importance of Being Earnest
credits.overview: Two young gentlemen living in 1890s England use the same pseudonym ('Ernest') on the sly, which is fine until they both fall in love with women using that name, which leads to a comedy of mistaken identities.

credits.title: Washingtonienne
credits.overview: A comedy that revolves around the professional and personal lives of three smart, sophisticated twenty-something girls working on Capitol Hill.

credits.title: Evening
credits.overview: As Constance (Natasha Richardson) and Nina (Toni Collette) gather at the deathbed of their mother, Ann (Vanessa Redgrave), they learn for the first time that their mother lived an entire other lifetime during one evening 50 years ago.
